body:
Tested locally, it works as expected. Code looks good to me.

All assertions pass in this script:

```gdscript
extends Node


func _ready() -> void:
	assert(true > false)
	assert(true >= false)
	assert(not (true == false))

	assert(not (false > false))
	assert(false >= false)
	assert(false == false)

	assert(not (false > true))
	assert(not (false >= true))
	assert(not (false == true))

	assert(not (true > true))
	assert(true >= true)
	assert(true == true)

```

Makes sense to me.

I would normally oppose this because ordering comparisons with bools could be easily misinterpreted, but we already have `<` and `>` for `bool`. 
Since removing them isn't a good option (breaks compat), we should at least make it less of a footgun by adding the operators uniformly.
